## Chapter Summary

Data visualization is a crucial component of data analysis, enabling the effective communication of insights through graphical representations. This chapter covers the fundamentals, advanced techniques, and tools.

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true"}
## Skills you will acquire in this chapter
- Select the right visualization for each data type
- Apply principles of effective visualization (readability, clarity, color)
- Use advanced techniques: multivariate, temporal, interactive visualizations
- Avoid common pitfalls: misleading graphs, information overload, axis distortion
:::
